the_warm_perimeter.owner_concept: The owner's own framing, and it is the organising idea: there is a WARM PERIMETER - the thermal envelope of the heated flat - and it is UNIFORM in construction all the way round.
the_warm_perimeter.owner_words: «[M1] is external wall, and it is uniform, the same thickness across all the warm perimeter. M1 is the external wall with all the insulation, because [the лоджия] was envisioned as a cold area. It's not heated, it's outside of this external wall perimeter.»
the_warm_perimeter.build_up: 300 mm autoclaved aerated concrete block + 70 mm mineral wool on the OUTSIDE + render and paint (developer spec).
the_warm_perimeter.note: Non-load-bearing: the monolithic RC frame carries everything. That does not make them alterable in practice - they are the façade.
the_warm_perimeter.critical_consequence: !! THE ЛОДЖИЯ IS OUTSIDE THE WARM PERIMETER, AND THE WALL BETWEEN THE FLAT AND THE ЛОДЖИЯ IS PART OF IT - fully insulated, 300 + 70. See loggia_thermal_consequence below; it changes the frost-free calculation.
the_warm_perimeter.insulation_note: !! NOT UNIFORM after all - 70 mm on the aerated-block walls but 150 mm where CONCRETE is exposed (R8, R9). See insulation_is_NOT_uniform_2026_09_04.

loggia_thermal_consequence.finding: !! THE ЛОДЖИЯ IS THERMALLY DECOUPLED FROM THE FLAT, AND THAT CUTS AGAINST THE OWNER'S OWN GOAL.
reasoning: The wall between the flat and the лоджия - M1, plus M7 and the insulated face of R8 - is full warm perimeter: 300 mm block with 70 mm of mineral wool.
So essentially NO heat leaks from the heated flat into the лоджия. One might otherwise have assumed some did.
M2 separates this лоджия from the neighbour's, and both are unheated - cold-to-cold, no help from that side either.
The лоджия's own enclosure is thin and uninsulated by design: M2 'thinner', M6b ~200 mm provisional.
The floor and ceiling are slabs shared with the loggias above and below, which are also unheated.
loggia_thermal_consequence.consequence: !! THE STANDING TARGET - keep the лоджия frost-free through an ordinary Belarusian winter with NO heating, on passive measures alone - therefore rests on exactly two things: SOLAR GAIN, and the лоджия's OWN enclosure. Nothing is contributed by the flat.
loggia_thermal_consequence.the_good_news: Solar gain is the best it could be: the лоджия's main angled glazing faces DUE SOUTH (confirmed orientation), making it the most solar-exposed element in the flat.
loggia_thermal_consequence.the_work: So the glazing upgrade the owner is already planning is doing nearly all of the work, and the thin uninsulated enclosure walls (M2, M6b) are the weak points. Whether the target is achievable at all is an open question the vault has already flagged as a content gap - see 00_Master/Family_Requirements.md section 10 - and this is the constraint set that question has to be answered against.
loggia_thermal_consequence.note_on_scope: The owner has decided NOT to join the лоджия to the flat and to keep its doors and windows. That decision is unaffected; what changes is where the heat has to come from.

insulation_is_NOT_uniform_2026_09_04.source: Owner marked it on _assets/outer_insulation.png (his annotation of my own face map). Isolated by pixel-diffing his image against my original, so the regions are exactly what he drew, not my reading of them.
insulation_is_NOT_uniform_2026_09_04.correction: !! THIS CORRECTS THE DEVELOPER SPEC, which states «утепленными минераловатными плитами толщиной 70мм» without qualification. The insulation is NOT uniform.

thick_150mm.note: Exactly two regions, and BOTH are on CONCRETE frame elements.

thin_70mm.note: Seven regions, all on the aerated-block external walls.

insulation_is_NOT_uniform_2026_09_04.why_it_explains_itself: !! CONCRETE CONDUCTS HEAT FAR BETTER THAN AERATED BLOCK, so an exposed frame element is a THERMAL BRIDGE and needs more insulation to compensate. 150 on concrete, 70 on block is exactly the pattern he marked - so the marking is internally coherent and does not need to be taken on trust.
insulation_is_NOT_uniform_2026_09_04.consequence_for_the_loggia: !! R8 IS THE FLAT/ЛОДЖИЯ WALL AND IT CARRIES THE THICKER 150. So even less heat reaches the лоджия than the earlier finding assumed - the frost-free-without-heating target rests on solar gain and the лоджия own enclosure, and essentially nothing else. This strengthens that finding rather than changing it.
insulation_is_NOT_uniform_2026_09_04.consequence_for_heat_loss: Any heat-loss calculation must use 150 mm over R8/R9 and 70 mm over the M-series, not a single figure. The thermal-bridge treatment is already designed in, which is a point in the building favour.

frame_thickness_derived.how: !! DERIVED FROM THE PLAN ITSELF, not asked: the plan prints 175 at each place a column meets a partition, and 250 - 75 = 175. The printed step only works arithmetically if the frame is 250 AND the partitions are 75, so it corroborates both at once - a stronger check than either figure alone.
frame_thickness_derived.answers: Q1 and Q6 of the thickness sheet.

general_thickness_rules_2026_09_04.source: Owner, stated as general rules rather than wall by wall.
rules: 1. Every INTERNAL wall on the flat's outer perimeter - to an adjacent flat, or to another area inside the building such as the common corridor - is 250 mm. Applies to G2, G3, G5, G4a.
2. All OUTER walls are 300 mm plus 70 mm insulation. Applies to M1, M3, M4, M5, M6a, M7.
3. CONCRETE walls are 250 mm, and where exposed they carry 150 mm insulation. Applies to R1a-R9, with the 150 on R8 and R9.
4. M2 is 200 mm aerated block with NO insulation - the divider to the adjacent лоджия.
general_thickness_rules_2026_09_04.resolves: !! G5 = 250 by rule 1, which CLOSES the 200-or-250 question. That was the last figure able to move the living room wall line, and therefore the Phase-2 combined zone.
general_thickness_rules_2026_09_04.state: THE THICKNESS MODEL IS NOW COMPLETE for all 30 block runs. Only two figures are not directly from the owner: G1 at 120 (inferred from the plan) and M6b at 200 (his own provisional revision, pending another plan).

insulation_follows_the_facade_not_the_en.finding: !! M6b IS insulated at 70 even though the лоджия is unheated, while M2 is explicitly NOT insulated. The difference is not thermal.
insulation_follows_the_facade_not_the_en.explanation: M6b is ON THE VISIBLE, RENDERED FAÇADE; M2 faces another лоджия and is never seen from outside. So the insulation follows the RENDERED FAÇADE PLANE, not the thermal envelope.
insulation_follows_the_facade_not_the_en.why_it_matters: !! An insulated лоджия wall does NOT mean the лоджия is inside the warm perimeter. It is not. Reading it the other way round would wrongly credit the лоджия with a thermal boundary it does not have, and the frost-free-without-heating target would look easier than it is.

two_level_model_2026_09_04.owner_insight: An opening does NOT divide a wall - the wall is one piece and is joined above the opening. His examples: G4c and G4e are one piece joined above the ванная door; the outer walls are continuous and joined above the window and door openings.
two_level_model_2026_09_04.the_rule_that_results: Combined with his earlier corner rule: SPLIT at a corner, or at a material / thickness change. DO NOT SPLIT at an opening. Openings stop being boundaries and become PROPERTIES OF A WALL.

MY_ERROR_CORRECTED.what: I split M1 from M7 and told the owner his own list was wrong. HE WAS RIGHT AND I WAS WRONG.
MY_ERROR_CORRECTED.why_I_got_it_wrong: I tested orientation by BOUNDING-BOX ASPECT RATIO. M7's box is 16 px wide by 38 tall, so it read as 'vertical'. A 16 px stub cannot express its own direction - the test was invalid for short pieces, and I applied it anyway and drew a confident conclusion from it.
MY_ERROR_CORRECTED.the_right_test: Whether two pieces share a BAND along the run axis. M1 y 740-775 and M7 y 743-781 share 32 px of band, so they are the same horizontal wall line. The 136 px gap between them is ~1480 mm - the лоджия door plus window unit, exactly as he said.
MY_ERROR_CORRECTED.lesson: !! A GEOMETRIC HEURISTIC MUST BE CHECKED AGAINST THE SIZE OF THE THING IT IS APPLIED TO. Aspect ratio is meaningless below a few times the wall thickness. And the owner knows his own flat - when his account and my raster measurement disagree, the measurement needs re-examining first, not his account.

openings_without_a_host.O5: middle-room door, printed 910 - spans between the R4 column and the G6 recess.

openings_without_a_host.why_that_is_correct: Both sit with CONCRETE on one side and BLOCK on the other, so no single wall runs through them. Under the split-at-a-material-change rule that is the right answer, not a gap in the model.
openings_without_a_host.but_worth_knowing: !! Each still needs a LINTEL spanning two different materials, with different movement and fixing behaviour on each side. Worth establishing before first fix rather than discovering on site.

O9_loggia_glazing_added.what: The owner: "we forgot about another opening... between M2 and M6b. It is full height and full length with no cladding, just window, big window from floor to ceiling."
O9_loggia_glazing_added.unique_property: !! IT IS THE ONLY OPENING IN THE FLAT WITH NO WALL ABOVE OR BELOW IT. So it has no head band and no sill band - the no-split-at-openings rule has nothing to apply to, because there is no wall there at all. Drawn DASHED for that reason.
O9_loggia_glazing_added.thermal_consequence: !!! AND IT CHANGES THE ЛОДЖИЯ SUM AGAIN, IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. The лоджия's ENTIRE south face is glass, floor to ceiling, facing DUE SOUTH. Solar gain is therefore at its theoretical maximum, which is the best possible case for the frost-free target. But heat loss through that face is also at its maximum, because there is no opaque wall in it at all - not even a sill band to store or resist. Combined with the earlier findings - nothing from the flat (MA is 300+70, R8 carries 150), nothing from the neighbour (M2 is cold-to-cold) - the target now rests ALMOST ENTIRELY ON THE GLAZING SPECIFICATION. It is a glass box on the warm side of the building. Anyone answering the frost-free question must treat the glazing as the whole of the design, not a component of it.
